item.title: Big Tech faces the courts, a scenario moved
item.comments: 🏳️ Judge Brinkema rejects the DOJ's forced breakup of AdX, "The courts back off, Big Tech wins" climbs to 50%, +20 points — a first clear ruling on the toughest remedy considered against Big Tech since Microsoft.
item.description:
🏳️ Judge Brinkema rejects the DOJ's forced breakup of AdX, "The courts back off, Big Tech wins" climbs to 50%, +20 points — this scenario climbs from 30% to 50%, while the courts-drag-on scenario falls from 50% to 45% and a real breakup of Google falls from 20% to 5%.

On September 2, 2026, Judge Leonie Brinkema rejected the DOJ's request to force Google to sell off AdX in the online-advertising antitrust case, upholding mostly behavioral remedies proposed by Google instead. The parties must jointly propose a final judgment within 30 days; the search case (Google's appeal over mandated data-sharing, and the DOJ's push for a forced Chrome sale) remains unresolved.

See the full update, scenario by scenario 👉 lesscenarios.fr/suivi/big-tech-justice.html

item.title: Golf, soccer, boxing: Is Saudi Arabia pulling back from sport?, a scenario moved
item.comments: LIV Golf lays off most of its staff and no longer rules out bankruptcy, the tight schedule doesn't hold +22 points (42%) — the "clean" exit praised in V1 falls back to 25% (-20 points).
item.description:
LIV Golf lays off most of its staff and no longer rules out bankruptcy, the tight schedule doesn't hold +22 points (42%) — this scenario climbs from 20% to 42%, while the "clean" exit falls from 45% to 25% and the persisting uncertainty edges down slightly from 35% to 33%.

Despite the investor deal announced on August 5, LIV Golf has been going through a severe financial rough patch since mid-August: its season-ending event's purse cut in half, players unpaid at Bedminster, mass layoffs, and four lawsuits from unpaid vendors filed between August 18 and 28. CEO Scott O'Neil no longer rules out the possibility of bankruptcy.

See the full update, scenario by scenario 👉 lesscenarios.fr/suivi/arabie-saoudite-sport.html
